svg.title: RTM1 — Stop line
svg.desc: Drawn to specification, not traced. Source: SARTSM Vol 1 §7.2.1(4); NRTR 2000 reg 286(2)(c)(i), reg 307. Continuous solid WHITE line, minimum 300 mm wide urban / 500 mm rural, across the full width of the approach. Deliberately NO 'STOP' legend — that is a separate word marking, and the chart vignette's legend was chart context.
